from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
task=Path("reports/T0007")
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
allowed={"docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","docs/implementation_status.md"}
for p,h in base["tracked_sha256"].items():
    if p not in allowed: assert sha(p)==h,p
assert not Path("src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py").exists()
assert not Path("tests/test_dependency.py").exists()
doc_paths=["docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","reports/T0007/planning-review.md"]
links=0
for name in doc_paths:
    p=Path(name); s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(line==line.rstrip() for line in s.splitlines()),name
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        target=target.strip("<>").split("#",1)[0]
        if target and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:",target):
            assert (p.parent/target).exists(),(name,target)
            links+=1
handoff=Path(doc_paths[0]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"ready"+chr(96) in handoff
assert all(f"- [ ] A{i}：" in handoff for i in range(1,8))
assert "T0007" in Path(doc_paths[1]).read_text()
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==base["head"]
p=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
status=subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--short"],text=True)
assert set(status.splitlines())=={
" M docs/decisions.md"," M docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md",
" M docs/implementation_status.md","?? docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","?? reports/T0007/"
},status
records={}
for run in ("planning-preflight","planning-checks"):
    d=task/run
    rec=json.loads((d/"record.json").read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished" and rec["exit_code"]==0
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"]
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"): assert sha(d/(stream+".txt"))==rec[stream+"_sha256"]
    records[run]={k:rec[k] for k in ("exit_code","elapsed_s","argv")}
artifacts=doc_paths+["reports/T0007/record_check.py","reports/T0007/.gitignore","reports/T0007/planning-baseline.json","reports/T0007/planning-checks/checks.json"]
audit={"checked_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"result":"PASS","task_status":"ready","product_acceptance":"not_run","head":base["head"],
"independent_reviewer":"/root/review_t0001_code","records":records,
"tracked_files_preserved_except_allowed_docs":len(base["tracked_sha256"])-len(allowed),
"source_files_created":False,"local_links_checked":links,"git_diff_check":"PASS",
"artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in artifacts},
"limits":["Planning/handoff only; no product implementation or product tests","No Pi launch","No commit/push"]}
(task/"planning-final-check/final-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(f"PASS: ready handoff, {links} local links, frozen source/history, allowed mutation scope")
print("PASS: no product/test implementation created; no commit/push")
